label: ThinkSystem SR630 V2 1U rack server
description: 1U two-socket rack server with a selectable 2-port LOM (1GbE or 10GbE) and a second selectable bay for an OCP 3.0 adapter up to 25GbE. The 1GbE XClarity Controller port is dedicated.
notes: Modelled with the 2x 1GbE LOM selection. The LOM connector and the OCP 3.0 slot are both factory-selectable, so a 10GbE LOM or a 10/25GbE OCP card can replace eth0/eth1 - the onboard copper ports are what is drawn here. Up to 3x PCIe 4.0 slots. XCC has its own 1GbE RJ-45 port.
